'''Alderaan night birds''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Bird/Legends|avian]] creatures that hailed from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Those nocturnal birds emitted cooing sounds.<ref name="TOR:D" />
